complex.source: Calibration 2026-09-29 (budget/calibration.md): complex bare r1 moved Codex weekly 94% -> 93% on its own. With whole-percent readings, a one-point step is at most 2 points of real use, so 2.0 is the upper bound.

scoring.source: Calibration 2026-09-29: the blind model scorer in --calibrate mode (every item) cost $0.50 to $0.70 per complex run; $0.70 x 0.41 %/$ = 0.29%. Runs scored without --calibrate send only low-confidence items, so this over-counts them.
